description: The left region of a desktop TmDocumentEditor (redesign DE-1.1, decision DE1): the document structure (heading outline, TmDocumentOutlinePanel) above the page thumbnails (TmDocumentPageNavigator), a collapse button and a 'Search in document' entry. The entry is a button styled as a field: it raises OnSearch and the editor opens its find panel - the panel owns no search logic. The column folds into a rail (Collapsed / CollapsedChanged, aria-expanded on the toggle); the editor starts it folded while a desktop container is narrower than 1280 px (TmBreakpoints.Xl) so the page keeps its room, and the reader's choice wins over the width. A tablet or phone container does not render this component: there Outline and Pages stay tabs of the inspector panel (DocumentSidePanelTab.Outline / Pages, kept for compatibility; on a desktop container they lead to this column).

parameters.name: ActiveBlockId
parameters.description: Heading block that is currently active in the document.

parameters.name: Metrics
parameters.description: Runtime page metrics reported by the canvas engine.

parameters.name: Collapsed
parameters.description: Whether the column is folded into its rail. Two-way with CollapsedChanged.

parameters.name: CollapsedChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user folds or unfolds the column.

parameters.name: OnNavigateToBlock
parameters.description: Raised when a heading is chosen.

parameters.name: OnNavigateToPage
parameters.description: Raised when a page thumbnail is chosen.

parameters.name: OnSearch
parameters.description: Raised by the 'Search in document' entry; the editor opens its find panel.

examples.title: Inside the editor (desktop container only)
examples.code:
<nav data-region="nav" data-focus-region="nav" aria-label="@Loc["TmDocumentEditor_NavigationLabel"]">
    <TmDocumentNavigationPanel Outline="@outline"
                               Metrics="@pageMetrics"
                               @bind-Collapsed="navCollapsed"
                               OnNavigateToBlock="NavigateToBlockAsync"
                               OnNavigateToPage="NavigateToPageAsync"
                               OnSearch="OpenFindAsync" />
</nav>
